violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed food employee, in hog trailer, putting on gloves without washing her hands. Hands should be washed before putting on gloves.

Reheating food. — --Commercially processed, properly packaged ready-to-eat food was not heated to a minimum temperature of 140F for hot holding. Hot dogs on roller grill found at 120F. Employees stated that they were ready for sale. Temperature chart kept by site did not show they reached 140F, as required. Fully cooked items being heated must reach 140F before serving.

Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. Thermometers were not located in Coke coolers near hog trailer. Thermometers should be provided in refrigerated units.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Disposable cups found stored on the floor of snack shack next to hand washing station. Single use items should be stored off of the floor.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Kettle corn stand does not have a hand washing station that is easily accessible. Hand washing stations must be easily accessible. Funnel cake stand hand washing station, portable, did not have water. Substituting with bucket with soap for all to wash. Hand washing station must be operated properly.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towels were not available at hand washing station in the snack shack. Paper towels should be available at all times. ***Corrected during inspection.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Floor of new kettle corn area is covered with wood. Floors should be smooth, easily cleanable surfaces.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Coke coolers at the Snack Shack were found dirty. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed food employees in the Hog House and the Snack Shack put on gloves and did not wash their hands first. Hands should be washed before putting on gloves.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Hand wash station at the Hog House was found blocked with bucket used to collect dirty towels. Handwashing stations should be easily accessible.
